subject: Next steps + who signs POs / procurement path (Aurora Health)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@aurorahealth.com>, Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & a quick ask on who owns budget/procurements

Hi Sarah / Michael —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap so we’re all aligned:

- What Aurora's evaluating: using an inference platform to run clinical-annotation workflows and patient-summary generation with predictable latency and cost.
- Pilot scope: 2 dev teams, ~5k inference requests/day, mixed short/long sequences.
- Security checklist flagged: SOC 2 summary, data residency expectations, and procurement contact to handle standard PO/SOW.

Immediate asks / suggested next steps:
1) Can you confirm the person who signs purchase orders or owns the budget for this initiative (title + email)? If it's legal/procurement, a point-of-contact there is fine.
2) We'll share a short eval pack (SOC2 summary + configuration guide) — I've attached a one-page SOC2 summary and the eval pack.
3) Proposed follow-up: 30-min procurement intro + technical kickoff next week (I can coordinate).

If you prefer I loop in a procurement contact at Aurora, feel free to reply-all.

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf (stub), redwood-evalpack-aurora-2026.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & a quick ask on who owns budget/procurements

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary — helpful. Short answers:
- Budget owner: I think this will land with our VP of Digital Transformation, Priya Rao (priya.rao@aurorahealth.com). She owns pilot budgets under $100k.
- Procurement: final approvals and POs are handled by Procurement (procure@aurorahealth.com), but legal may want to review security artifacts for the pilot.

I’m looping Michael because he’s the tech sponsor and will run the evaluation with his team (cc’d). I’ll introduce Priya in a separate note after I sync with her.

Quick clarifying Q: can you confirm whether Redwood can support an on-prem connector (private VPC) for the pilot? If so, Michael and I will prioritize SOC2 and network details.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Digital Programs | Aurora Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@aurorahealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@aurorahealth.com>, procure@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: procurement + budget owner (Priya) — suggested next steps

Hi Priya (and team) —

Per Sarah’s note, looping you in. Hi — I’m Karthik on the Redwood team; we spoke with Sarah + Michael about a pilot to run inference for clinical-annotation and summaries.

To accelerate:
- Quick ask: can you confirm the nominal PO threshold you directly approve (if any) and whether a standard SOW + PO combo is the right path?
- We can limit pilot spend to a pre-agreed cap and provide a standard pilot SOW.
- Technical note: Redwood supports a private VPC connector for pilot workloads; our infra team will provide a network diagram and a short on-prem connector runbook.

I’ve attached the SOC2 summary and an eval pack with suggested pilot config. If useful, Logan (cc) can join a 20-min technical Q&A to walk the network/ops details.

Suggested immediate cadence:
1) Procurement intro (30 min) with Priya + procure@aurorahealth.com (this week)
2) Technical kickoff (30 min) with Michael + Redwood infra (next week)

If you prefer, I can set up a combined 30-min call so procurement and tech can align in one shot.

Thanks — would appreciate any clarity on who signs and the PO threshold.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf, redwood-evalpack-aurora-2026.pdf

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aurorahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: procure@aurorahealth.com, Michael O'Neal <m.oneal@aurorahealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: procurement + budget owner (Priya) — suggested next steps

Hi Karthik / Sarah —

Thanks for the intro. Short answers:
- PO threshold: I can approve pilots up to $75k. Above that, we require Procurement + Legal sign-off.
- Procurement contact: procure@aurorahealth.com (copied) will handle the PO flow; Legal will review security artifacts but only at formal SOW stage.

I’m available for a procurement intro Thursday 8/2 at 10am PT or Friday 8/3 at 9am PT — either works for me. If you prefer a single combined session with technical folks, schedule the 60-minute slot and I’ll block it.

Priya Rao
VP, Digital Transformation | Aurora Health
